National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. 
 
 CIN U45201WB2005PLC904417 · GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1 · Salt Lake, Kolkata 
 
 
 PROJECT COMPLETION CERTIFICATE 
 
 Issued by the Contractor 
 
 Ref: NICL/CC/21/31/0 Date: 31/03/2026 
 
 1. PROJECT PARTICULARS 
 
 The following table records the particulars of the work certified below, drawn from the measurement and
 billing records for the contract. 
 
 Project Name Road Widening - Maharashtra Pkg-21 
 
 Client Public Works Department, Govt of Maharashtra (Government)
 
 Scope of Work Roads Highways works for Public Works Department, Govt of
 Maharashtra completed 2011. 
 
 Work Category Roads Highways 
 
 Contract Value INR 19.33 Cr 
 
 Completion Date 2011-04-22 
 
 Project Manager Neha Chopra 
 
 2. DECLARATION OF COMPLETION 
 
 The work was executed under site conditions that included hard rock encountered below the founding level
 over part of the alignment. Third-party inspection was arranged for the structural elements, and the client's
 
 representative assessed the completed work as Very Good. 
 We, National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd., the undersigned contractor, hereby certify that the above-mentioned
 project has been completed in all respects in accordance with the contract terms, approved drawings, technical
 
 specifications, and applicable Indian Standards (IS codes). 
 The work has been executed under the supervision of our project management team and has been found
 
 satisfactory during all interim inspections conducted by the client's authorized representatives.
 
 3. COMPLIANCE SUMMARY 
 
 Parameter Status 
 
 Scope Completion 100% - All deliverables completed 
 
 Quality Standards Compliant with IS codes and contract specifications 
 
 Safety Compliance BOCW Act provisions followed; zero LTI

 4. MILESTONE SUMMARY 
 
 
 Milestone Planned Actual Status 
 
 Site Mobilisation 2011-04-22 2011-04-22 Completed

 5. DEFECT LIABILITY PERIOD 
 During the period stated the contractor shall make good, at its own cost, any defect attributable to workmanship
 
 or materials that comes to notice. Retention money is released on expiry of that period once the client is
 satisfied no such defect remains outstanding. 
 
 The defect liability period of 365 days from the date of completion (i.e., until 2012-04-21) remains in force.
 Any defects observed during this period shall be rectified at our cost without additional charge to the client.
 
 We request the client to kindly issue the final completion certificate and release the retention money as per the
 contract terms. 
 
 FOR AUTHORISED USE ONLY 
 
 
 Neha Chopra Director (Projects) 
 
 Project Manager National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd.
 National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd.
